author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Hello viewers, here is the updated, new & improved review on Truncatis, me and _iman''s 3 monument DTM. XML is needed for it still + the download. I hope u guys like the map design :D

Team colours - Orange & Light Blue or Orucia & Libluef

Team sizes - 16 for each team and if you cant be bothered with maths - 32 total capacity

Made by- Skiizii & iman 
 
ScreenShots - http://imgur.com/a/yjfec

Thanks again :D!
